name: Kopifund
author: c-wenlong

control._comment: Single container; the data folder it mounts is a git-crypt clone synced by a separate user timer, which is not a part the launcher should stop.

login: No sign-in: loopback and the tailnet are the boundary. Phones pair once from Settings -> Link a phone (QR), then read over the tailnet with a device bearer.
description: Kopifund personal finance tracker (private c-wenlong/kopifund-finance repo): bank/wallet/brokerage/CPF PDF statements parsed into one categorised ledger, from a Singapore user's own accounts. Built from a machine-managed clone at ~/services/kopifund/repo, hard-reset per deploy; the container it makes mounts the data folder at ~/.kopifund — upstream's own data root — which is an unlocked git-crypt clone of the private kopifund-hub repo: the versioned, Mac-shared state. A systemd user timer / LaunchAgent snapshots it back to the hub every SYNC_SECONDS and merges the other machines' snapshots (newer tip wins a raced file; the loser is kept as <name>.loser-<sha>). Replaces the launcher's From-GitHub deployment of the same app.
